provenance_note: Observed Claude Code policy rendering/refusal after explicit /circuit-spec-integration invocation with a frozen evidence packet. Deterministic forward fixtures separately prove routing and evidence discovery; these runs do not claim independent model discovery of IDs.

runs.prompt: Change the STUSB4500QTR C2678061 NVM policy to request 15 V and prove the UMW AO3401A C347476 load switch remains safely off through dead-battery, reset, attach, hard reset, fault, and disconnect.

conditions: mirror-only STUSB trust; NVM/readback/as-built state absent
ideal VBEN-low divider gives VGS -6 V at 15 V, -8 V at 20 V, -12.96 V at conditioned 32.4 V TVS table point
nominal gate tau approximately 6 ms excluding device/parasitic/waveform effects
response.refusal: Safety proof cannot be established without as-built NVM readback, dynamic gate, parasitic and waveform evidence, reset and fault sequencing, and bench or simulation evidence; no design change is authorized.

runs.prompt: Evaluate changing the installed FNR4030S4R7MT C167874 inductor value/package and CL21A226MAQNNNE C45783 output-capacitor population around AP63203WU-7 C780769; recalculate saturation, heating, timing, and effective capacitance over the full V15 and load envelope.

conditions: V15 transients, EN-open startup, switching timing, actual 3V3 load steps, inductor heat/saturation, effective capacitance, layout and MCU state
FNR isat/irated margin now primary-confirmed; irated margin remains negative (2.7 A target vs 2.0 A primary Irms max)
response.refusal: No substitution or change is authorized until primary minimum-off-time and inductor evidence and installed effective capacitance close.

runs.prompt: Raise the STM32G031F8P6 C529334 PWM ceiling for the AL8860MP-13 C500782 LED stage and prove LED junction, FOJAN FRC2512F33R0TS C2934070 ballast, NTC sensing, enclosure thermal state, and firmware thresholds remain safe.

conditions: NTC divider ADC acquisition and firmware thresholds
response.refusal: No PWM change is authorized until measured junction, waveform and enclosure state, sourced ADC and NTC firmware thresholds, branch sharing, and thermal path close.
